description: Your sharp mind and keen burgling skills led you to fall in with the Ninth Quill, a collective of thieves, saboteurs, and spies who steal magical lore and relics from others. Through your escapades—from purloining magic items and arcane tomes to sabotaging groups of mages—you've developed cunning skills and magical tricks to further your spy craft.

Publicly, you're a courtier, a mediator, or an entertainer. But behind that glamorous visage is a mind honed for gathering secrets. Trained by the enchanters of the Bejeweled Conclave, you know how to use your charm and wit (plus a little magic) to infiltrate organizations, uncover information, and broker deals.

Your body has been warped by the transmutation practices of the Bringers of the Cosmic Dawn. Perhaps you were inadvertently caught up in one of the organization's experiments, or maybe you were a member of the organization and sought to improve your physical form through magical might. Whatever the case, you use your strange anatomy to your benefit.

Death has always fascinated you. You've studied that morbid topic alongside members of the Covenant of the Grave, analyzing the macabre with scientific precision. Through these studies, you've amassed knowledge of medication, necromancy, and history.

Your daredevil tendencies and thirst for excitement led you to the Crucible Keepers, an organization dedicated to studying natural and magical catastrophes. From playing with molten glass to charging into a hurricane's eye, you thrive when disaster is mere steps away.

A magical familiar bonded with you when you were young, accompanying you throughout your adolescence. Now, you can't imagine life without your furry—or feathery, scaly, or slimy—friend at your side. You've learned to work in tandem with your familiar, and when adventure presents its challenges, your familiar is quick to remind you of the small joys in life.

Your adolescence was marked by unquenchable wanderlust. You left home and began your travels as soon as you were able. Along the way, you encountered the adventurous conjurers of the Horizon Weavers, who taught you some of their teleportation magic to further your explorations.

Whether as a performer or a circus hand, you found a home among the members of the Phantasmic Circus. As you traveled across the world bringing magic and wonder to excited audiences, you learned some illusion magic and honed your talents for performance and misdirection.

As an apprentice among the Seers of Sea and Sky, you learned to interpret minor omens from the clouds above and the fathoms below. The organization's rich network of libraries furthered your education, and you now travel across the world, imparting advice and aid to others.

A turn of ill luck led you to the Sheltering Hands, an altruistic organization dedicated to defending the downtrodden. The organization helped you regain your footing and taught you some of its protective magic—in the hope that one day you too would shelter the less fortunate in their time of need.
